selection_policy: Aligned exactly with the formal Merge Memory-OFF seeds: consecutive integers 0 through 19 in deterministic ascending order.
memory_lifecycle_classification: RELEASED-CODE-DERIVED + OUR EXPERIMENT DESIGN; not paper-explicit
